notes.title: Tango Rio spotted in Rome…
notes.content:
And you thought he got elected Pope.Well—not quite… but we’re working on it. 
😇One thing’s for sure: Tango Rio is at the gates of the Vatican.
From [b]May 8th to 11th[/b], we’ll be in the heart of Trastevere—one of Rome’s most beautiful neighborhoods—for the [b]Rome Video Game Lab 2025.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45303334/7f0216a67f72b86eb2f7e1374d9d38a6f0e3a7bc.png[/img]

📍 A historic location. A cultural event. The perfect setting for a story full of twists—just like in our game, where mysterious Vatican vaults play a key role.Maybe it was fate that brought Tango to Rome.

[h3]Where to find us?[/h3]
At [b]WeGil[/b], inside the [b]Indie Showcase[/b]: an area full of games, developers, nerdy chats, and (hopefully) free coffee.We really need that coffee. 🤞

[h3]What’s new?[/h3]
🎮 We’re debuting our brand-new playable demo, and it’ll be coming to Steam soon too!
Come play it, say hi, and ask us the weirdest questions you’ve got. Like:“Does Tango… believe in signs from the universe?”When we become Popes, we’ll get back to you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45303334/29b3e693d10a60574995be160694f27a846ad9c0.png[/img]

[b]Rome Video Game Lab[/b] is the Italian festival that celebrates video games as a cultural medium.Tango adds a lost letter, a splash of satire, and a mystery centuries in the making.
We’ll see you there!And of course…[b] don’t forget to wishlist the game.[/b]
It’s basically a digital blessing.Tango’s not Pope yet—but like we said… we’re working on it.

notes.title: Tango Rio sets course for Indie Assemble
notes.content:
A global event, a digital stage, a tidal wave of [b]indie games[/b] (over 1,000 of them!) from 600 studios around the world.
And we’re thrilled to announce that [b]The Adventures of Tango Rio[/b] will be there too. Amazing, right?

Organized by [b]Excaliber, Indie Assemble[/b] is a massive celebration of independent games (just like any true adventurer deserves to be). It’s a chance to discover creative projects from all corners of the globe, and to add them to your wishlist (like ours 😏. You know… no pressure).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45303334/d704e0657b64798758188bc8567ff6977c1d884f.jpg[/img]

[h3]Where to find us?
[/h3]
The Adventures of Tango Rio is right in the eye of the storm, featured in the "Wishlist. Wishlist Everywhere!" section, dedicated to upcoming titles that are still cooking but ready to be discovered.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/44717737/sale/IndieAssemble]🎯 Link to the event[/url]

[i]Join the conversation with the hashtag #IndieAssemble[/i]

Not to repeat ourselves buuuuut… don’t forget the wishlist!
It’s the best way to support us — and to get a notification when the game is ready.

notes.title: Welcome to Tango Rio DevLog #0
notes.content:
Welcome, Adventurers
The [b]Bean Adventure Agency[/b] is ready to take you on the bizarre (mis)adventures of [b]Tango Rio[/b] — a humble mailman who’s unwillingly shipped off to Polynesia.

An epic adventure…
Well, not quite. It’s a [b]point-and-click game.[/b]
But it’s crafted with love, drawn entirely by hand, and we’ll be documenting it step by step in this captain’s log. (Alright, it’s a devlog. But “captain’s log” just sounds cooler.)

[h3]How did we get here?[/h3]
Back in 2020, we lit the spark, without knowing how to do pretty much anything.
After years of work (and plenty of mistakes), we launched a [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/beanadventureagency/the-adventures-of-tango-rio]Kickstarter campaign[/url] in 2024 that turned out to be a success (thanks to many of you).
It gave us the push we needed to keep going.
(Some rewards are still available through a Late Pledge so, yeah... think about it.)
Now here we are, not just to [b]make a game[/b], but to share the journey with you, all the way to the final stop.

[h3]Are we newbies?[/h3]
Always. Every adventure feels like the first.
But we’ve already set sail once with [url=https://bean-adventure-agency.itch.io/the-booze-of-monkey-island]The Booze of Monkey Island[/url], a fan game that taught us two things:
[list]
[*] Making games is amazing.
[*] We want to make an even better one.
[/list]
[h3]What you’ll find here
[/h3][list]
[*] Exclusive artwork: sketches, colors, as fresh as a coconut rinse
[*] Behind the scenes: yes, our dev is awkward (you’ll see)
[*] Demos, bugs, creative breakdowns: the sea’s rough, but we’re rowing hard
[/list]
Pack your bags
Follow the devlog, mark the date on your calendar (or on a treasure map, if you’re into that).
If you’ve never been to Polynesia…this one’s even better. It’s all hand-drawn.

Follow us and set sail.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45303334/c2c06a5e1eb1cd370088559da370f594bedb1a4e.png[/img]
